title: Pre-transplant Health Coaching to Improve Patient-Reported Outcomes in Lung Transplant Candidates
official: Pre-transplant Health Coaching to Improve Patient-Reported Outcomes in Lung Transplant Candidates
summary: To examine the effectiveness of an individual health coaching intervention for lung transplant candidates. This intervention will include up to 12 health coaching sessions via phone call over a 12-16 week period. This will be compared to a usual care group the receives pre-transplant care and education alone.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Waitlisted or deferred for lung transplantation at Mayo Clinic Rochester, Mayo Clinic Florida, or University of Washington

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 18 years old
* Non-English speaking, nonverbal, or extremely hard of hearing
